Brown wood desk under an olive wall. Top-left chip reads 'Illustration. Generic car with no brand mark'. A small 'Federal recall record' card sits upper left with a wooden rubber stamp to its right. Below, a 10-wide grid of dashed outlines fills row by row with small white car icons, from 2 rows at 25.0 s to 8 rows at 25.8 s. A dark caption box reads 'that could affect nearly thirty eight hundred cars.'

The car grid is full at 8 by 10 icons. From 26.4 s a long flat blue tube arm with a tan hand enters from the right and slides a cream note 'Nearly 3,800 vehicles / 3,791 potentially affected in the record' beside the record card. The arm crosses the car grid diagonally. Same caption.

The blue arm presses the stamp and an amber 'Software recall' imprint appears across the record card's top rows. The 'Nearly 3,800 vehicles' note is pinned at right. The arm withdraws by 27.6 s and the stamp is back on the desk. Same caption, grid unchanged.

28.0 to 28.2 s holds the desk record. Cut at 28.4 s to a roadside wide shot: pale sky, two trees, a small city skyline, a gray two-lane road, and a white car with a roof dome entering at the left edge. Green leaf-like blobs sit on the lane. Chip reads 'Illustration. The recall wording, not a recorded event'. A faint quote card fades in. Caption 'The recall says the software may let a car slow,'.

The quote card is fully visible: 'Federal recall record. The software may allow the vehicle to slow and then drive into standing water on higher speed roadways.' The white car travels left to center along the lane. Green blob shapes on the road pass under its front wheels and read as foliage, not clearly water. Same caption. The car sits just above the caption box.

The car holds near center while the background streetlight slides left (camera tracking). Red tail and brake lights glow at 30.6 to 30.8 s. At 30.8 s a pale gray rectangular slab appears at the right road edge. Quote card and caption unchanged.

The car keeps its brake lights on at center. A pale gray flat rectangle (meant as standing water) lies on the lane ahead at right, with hard straight edges. A streetlight pole passes. Quote card and caption unchanged.

The car eases toward the gray slab at right, still in the wide shot. At 32.8 s it cuts to a medium side view: the car is large and spans the frame, with roof sensor dome, wheel detail and a headlight glow puff. The quote card is enlarged above it. Gray wall background, olive ground below.

Medium side view of the white car, stationary in frame. A translucent gray water slab with a vertical hard edge sits just ahead of the front bumper at right. Caption 'then drive into standing water on higher speed roads.' sits directly under the wheels.

The car's front end overlaps the gray slab. At 34.2 s the word 'may' in the quote card is highlighted amber. A blocky rectangular darker patch shows under the front wheel, a visible seam. White wake streaks start at the front wheel from 34.6 s. The background pole drifts left.

The car sits with its front wheels in the gray water plane. Spray and wake lines at the front tire, and a mirrored reflection under the car. A rectangular seam patch is visible beneath the chassis. The pole keeps sliding left, so the camera tracks while the car holds. 'may' is still highlighted.

Same medium shot of the car in the water plane, with wake streaks and reflection. A rectangular darker seam band is visible under the car. The pole moves out left. No crash or stop event is visible. The caption box sits right under the water contact line.

Cut back to the desk. A large 'Federal recall record' card with rows: Recall type Software, Potential units affected 3,791, Summary, Remedy 'The remedy is currently under development.', Interim remedy 'Weather-related constraints increased. Vehicle maps updated.', Interim update 'All affected vehicles by April 20th, 2026'. Amber 'Software recall' stamp. The remedy row highlights pale amber from 37.4 s. Caption 'The federal record says the remedy is currently under development.'
The record card holds with the remedy row highlighted and the stamp below at right. At 38.6 s a blue tube arm with a tan hand holding a pen enters from the lower right corner. Same caption.

The camera pushes in on the record. The pen arm crosses the card diagonally and its shaft covers the remedy row text ('The remedy is currently under development' is partly occluded). A second blue arm lifts the wooden stamp at lower right. The arms are flat untextured tubes. Same caption.

The stamp arm brings the stamp down onto the remedy row while the pen arm still lies across it. An amber imprint begins ('...elopment' partly legible). Remedy row text is mostly hidden under the two arms and the stamp.

An amber 'development' imprint lies on the remedy row, but the pen arm still covers the original row text. The caption disappears at 41.2 s. Cut at 41.6 s to an outdoor lot: power line between poles, an 'April' calendar sign, a 'Vehicle maps' card, skyline and trees, four small white cars in marked bays. Caption 'As an interim step, Waymo tightened its weather limits,'.

The lot scene holds: four small white cars, April calendar sign, Vehicle maps card on the wire pole, skyline. Nearly static, with only a small cream card edge appearing at upper left at 42.8 s. Caption unchanged.
A cream tag with a rain cloud icon, 'Weather limits tightened', slides in from the left along the wire and settles pinned beside the April calendar by 43.4 s. Cars stay static. Caption unchanged.

Static hold of the lot: Weather limits tag pinned, April calendar, Vehicle maps card, four parked white cars. No visible change across 44.0 to 44.8 s. Caption 'As an interim step, Waymo tightened its weather limits,'.
The lot holds, then a slight camera reframe right and closer at 45.6 s. No caption at 45.4 to 45.6 s, then 'and every affected car had the update by April twentieth.' appears at 45.8 s. Cars static.

The calendar page flips: a large '20' under the 'April' header, with the old page lifting away above at 46.2 to 46.6 s. Weather limits tag and Vehicle maps card unchanged. Four cars static. Same caption.
Hold on 'April 20' calendar, Weather limits tag, maps card and four cars. At 47.8 s a small round check badge appears above the first car. Same caption.
White check badges pop in above the cars one by one, left to right, all four by 48.8 s. The Vehicle maps card gains a check and 'updated' at 48.6 to 48.8 s. Same caption.
Hold: four cars with check badges, 'Vehicle maps updated' check, April 20 calendar, Weather limits tag. The caption disappears at 49.8 s. No other change.

Cut to an airport pickup curb: canopy on posts, a blue sign with plane and car icons and a down arrow, bench, phone leaning on bench, teal suitcase, skyline. White car parked in a marked bay. Phone inset upper left shows a map route and 'Arriving'. Chip reads 'Illustration. A generic airport ride, not the flood cars'. Caption 'So the airport ride is open,' from 50.2 s.
The car's rear side door slides open from 51.2 s, showing a dark empty interior with a tan seat. No person visible. Phone inset and sign unchanged. Same caption.

Door-open hold through 52.6 s, with the caption hidden at 52.6 s. At 52.8 s a cut to a wider curb view: the car is smaller and mid-frame with its door open, sign at right, a large empty dark road below, and a grass strip and gray slab at the bottom edge.

Wide curb view holds: white car with door open in the bay, airport sign, bench and suitcase, a dashed lane line, an empty road, and a grass patch with dry tufts plus a flat gray strip at the bottom. Caption 'and the federal record lists the flood remedy'. No remedy card visible yet.
